global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu, menma, and naruto fish cake, topped by a large nori sheet. Served in a white bowl with blue swirls, it rests on a black tray under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue swirling pattern, smooth glossy surface, and slightly raised decorative rim.
regions.soup: Golden-brown shoyu broth with noodles, garnished with green onions and a pink fish cake, appears rich and savory.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green and black, with a rough, slightly glossy texture and irregular, crinkled shape.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows browned, tender texture with visible fat marbling and slightly curled edges.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, curved pieces with smooth surfaces and faint natural striations.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: oval, golden-brown, with pink swirl pattern on surface, slightly textured.
